offence: Breach of Article 48.1 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and special grid location video. The car's front tyres were ahead of the grid box at the time of the Start Signal. This is considered a "False Start" under Art 48.1.c of the FIA Formula Sporting Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 False Start
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
